task.description: Design tests for VLD-01/02/03 (POST /api/v1/definitions/:id/validate). Every MUST acceptance criterion (AC) in docs/requirements.yaml for VLD-01, VLD-02, VLD-03 must have at least one integration test. No test coverage may be deferred. Tests must be self-sufficient (no reliance on external state). Fixtures must be isolated per test. Do NOT write test source code yet — this step produces the test SPECIFICATION only. Save the spec to tests/specs/vld-01-03-stage-16-validation.spec.md with sections: test inventory per AC, test design rationale, expected fixtures (test definition JSON for each scenario), expected outcomes, lint_test_wiring plan. The lint_test_wiring tool will verify every AC has at least one test file reachable from the build test graph.

VLD-01: Reachable-output check (every expression site references only output expressions of nodes earlier in the graph)
Per-form scoping (form fields scoped to declared form schema only)
Closed ErrorKind enum (7 variants: TypeMismatch, OperandTypeError, UnknownVariable, EmptyExpression, UnknownVariableType, UndeclaredResultSchema, ConflictingFieldType)
Deterministic ordering (sorted by node_id then expression_path)
VLD-02: Type mapping table for built-in operators (==, !=, +, -, *, /, <, <=, >, >=, &&, ||, !)
Operand-type error when operand types do not match operator expectations
Edit-distance-based suggestion for UnknownVariable (Levenshtein ≤4 against reachable variables)
PD-06 syntax gate: if CEL syntax fails, return early with PD-06 diagnostics only
EmptyExpression error kind when expression is empty/whitespace
VLD-03: Env construction from definition + form schemas (TypedEnv)
Scope resolution per expression site (forward-reachable DFS for node outputs, per-form scoping for form fields)
Type-check results exposed as findings (not raised exceptions)
Findings sorted and deduped before wire
Tenant-scoped read: 404 when definition belongs to another tenant

constraints: Every MUST AC has at least one integration test
No test coverage deferred (no 'covered by unit test' without an integration test)
Fixtures isolated per test (no shared mutable state)
Tests self-sufficient (no reliance on previous test ordering)
No implementation code in this step (spec only)

result.summary: Test specification for VLD-01/02/03 (POST /api/v1/definitions/:id/validate) complete. Spec covers all 15 MUST ACs: 12 land in tests/integration/validation_vld_unit_test.zig (handler-direct path, BPM_TEST_DB_URL only); 5 land in tests/integration/validation_vld_http_test.zig (HTTP boundary path, BPM_TEST_URL + BPM_TEST_TOKEN). 16 test blocks total (VLD-02 AC1 split into 12 positive operator passes + 1 negative OperandTypeError). Sections: §1 test inventory (AC → test name → file), §2 design rationale (why integration over pure unit, edge-case coverage), §3 12 concrete fixtures (happy path, unreachable output, form scoping, PD-06 syntax, unknown variable, edit-distance suggestion, operand type, empty expression, 13-operator mapping table, tenant scoping, three-finding aggregate, closed enum), §4 expected outcomes (HTTP status + response body shape per test), §5 lint_test_wiring plan (build.zig wiring, narrow test-integration-vld-* steps, addTest artefacts, main_test.zig imports), §6 coverage matrix (15/15 ACs), §7 out-of-scope (VLD-04, PD-02, PD-06 catalogue, JSON Schema, wasm, UI), §8 open questions — none.
